'''Y 4''' was the designation used by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while piloting a [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]] attached to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Ring Base]].

==History==
Pursuing the wayward [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] after a near crash landing into the Ring Base, Skywalker used this Y-wing to land on [[Panna Prime]].
There, he separated the cockpit from the rest of the fighter, to avoid a [[Panna dragon|dragon-like]] creature.
The ship was ultimately left behind in a ruined state, having been partially devoured by the creature.
